Round 87 took this capability as a rejected-honest-stop because its 12-arm scorer could not tell worktree binding from revision binding. Read the FROZEN /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kumitate-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-88/plan.md and the FROZEN 20-arm scorer /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kumitate-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-88/probe/probe88-c1.mjs BEFORE any work; both are byte-frozen at freeze commit 114877a308ffc0bcd63e354bcef03e6b9fe538d4 and are never edited.
